message.content: I wake up at six every morning, have a quick yoghurt for breakfast, and then I cycle to the bakery. It's a short ride, maybe ten minutes. I usually get there by seven. My job is pretty routine—labeling the bread trays, wrapping the loaves, and cleaning the counter. I like the rhythm of it, actually. It helps me feel grounded. Sometimes, though, I hear a voice when I'm alone. It's not loud, just... there. I don't know what it means. It doesn't bother me too much, but it's strange.
